query: What is the payment link for this property?
response:
The payment link for this property is: https://www.rentcafe.com/residentservices/apartmentsforrent/userlogin.aspx

This link will take you to the RentCafe resident portal, where you can securely make your rent payments online. To use this portal, you'll need to create an account or log in if you already have one. Through this portal, you can set up one-time payments or recurring automatic payments for your convenience.

Remember to have your account information ready when accessing the portal for the first time. If you encounter any issues or need assistance with the online payment system, please don't hesitate to contact the property management office.
